summary: A senator has committed to prioritizing D.C. statehood, while advocacy groups continue highlighting recent federal interventions in the District—including a National Guard deployment and a federal takeover—as evidence for why statehood is needed. The groups are also urging House lawmakers to protect D.C.'s fiscal independence against what they describe as a sweeping attack. Without statehood, D.C. cannot control its own National Guard deployments and Congress can override D.C.'s budget and spending decisions.

articles.title: VIDEO: Senator Slotkin Commits to Making DC Statehood a Top Priority
One Year Later, DC Vote Says Federal Takeover Underscores the Urgency of DC Statehood

DC Vote Urges House Committee to Reject Sweeping Attack on DC’s Fiscal Independence
